deadline.value: Polymer Science applicants must have all documents in by February 15 for full fall consideration.
deadline.quote: All required documents are due to the Office of Graduate Admissions by February 15 for full fall consideration.

also.quote: Applied Biology, Chemistry and Polymer Science Doctor of Philosophy (Ph.D.) Applicants

gre_general.value: The Kennedy College lists GRE only for Medical Physics and Radiological Sciences, so the Polymer Science PhD does not require it.
gre_general.quote: Graduate Record Examination (GRE) scores are only required for the following programs: | Medical Physics and Radiological Sciences.

gre_subject.value: No subject test applies to Polymer Science, and the catalog does not mention one.

supervisor.value: The page says the plan of study is set with an advisory committee but does not say whether a supervisor must agree before admission.

funding.value: The Polymer Science page does not describe PhD funding.

entry_route.value: The degree takes four years beyond a bachelor's, or two to three years beyond a master's.
entry_route.quote: The doctoral degree normally requires four years of full-time study beyond the bachelor's degree or a minimum of two to three years of full-time study beyond the master's degree.

notes: Polymer Science PhD in the Chemistry department, saved as the materials program. The Plastics Engineering PhD (Francis College of Engineering, a second materials-type doctorate) is not saved as a separate record because the materials field holds one record.
